initiatives.name: BeYoUUU
initiatives.description: Nonprofit in Little Rock serving Black, Indigenous and people of color transmasculine and gender non-conforming people with peer mentorship, support groups, direct financial help, and a gender-affirming closet.

initiatives.name: Little Rock Freedom Fund
initiatives.description: Black-led group in Little Rock that pays cash bail for people across Arkansas and offers court rides, mutual aid, know-your-rights trainings and organizing.

initiatives.name: Rock City Defense
initiatives.description: Little Rock group founded in 2025 that offers firearm and self-defense training and emergency preparedness, aimed at protecting immigrants, women, LGBTQ+ people and others targeted by the far right.

initiatives.name: It's The Van
initiatives.description: Little Rock nonprofit that drives supplies like food, water, clothing and hygiene items to unhoused people, and runs a donation warehouse, a farm, and a cold-weather shelter.

initiatives.name: Food Justice United of Arkansas
initiatives.description: Coordinates harm reduction programs, hosts and supports mutual aid Free Stores and resources-access programs through collaboration with food banks, community and governmental entities, extending the reach of their goals of community mutual aid and empowerment.
